item.title: Watercolour Cottage by a Stream

turns.text: Make a square watercolour illustration of a little stone cottage beside a stream, with soft green hills behind it. No text.

item.tests: Whether the output visibly follows a named illustration style while preserving the requested scene.

answer_sheet.Style: Watercolour, with soft washes and visible paper texture.
answer_sheet.Scene: A little stone cottage beside a stream, with soft green hills behind it.

must_haves: The image visibly resembles watercolour, with translucent washes and softly blended edges rather than a photographic or 3D-rendered finish.
A little stone cottage is a clearly recognizable subject.
A stream runs beside the cottage.
Soft green hills appear behind the cottage.
The composition is square and contains no text.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a watercolour illustration of a little stone cottage beside a stream. I've been picturing a place like this as a little mental escape when things feel busy. The image should be square, and there should be soft green hills behind the cottage. I think that's why I keep coming back to this particular scene. Please don't include any text.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: A peaceful watercolour illustration of a little stone cottage beside a gently flowing stream, with soft green rolling hills behind the cottage. A quiet, restorative countryside retreat: weathered natural stone walls, a modest slate roof, cozy small windows, grasses and delicate wildflowers along the stream banks, smooth stones visible beneath clear shallow water. Gentle daylight, soft sage and moss greens, muted warm stone colours, pale blue sky, delicate transparent watercolor washes, subtle pigment blooms and textured watercolor paper, softly feathered edges, handmade painterly illustration rather than a photograph. Balanced square composition with the cottage as focal point and the stream curving gently through the foreground. Calm, inviting, unhurried atmosphere, a little mental escape from a busy day. No text, no lettering, no signage, no watermark.
